log.verdict: checker rejected: The headline introduces interpretive language not present in the official item. The official item merely lists the agenda topic (a statute authorizing closed session discussion of performance evaluations) and the subject (City Manager). The headline's phrase 'reviews...performance evaluation' characterizes an action or outcome that is not explicitly stated in the official item text. The item establishes authority for discussion under Gov. Code 54957(b), but does not confirm that a review will occur, has occurred, or what form any discussion will take.
